name: EasyCast
subtitle: Cast web videos to your TV
description: Source for EasyCast: an in-app browser that casts detected videos to Chromecast / Google TV.

apps.name: EasyCast
apps.subtitle: Cast web videos to your TV
apps.localizedDescription: An in-app browser that detects videos on web pages and casts them to Chromecast / Google TV.

versions.localizedDescription: Casting now works on sites that block outside access: if a video can't be fetched directly, EasyCast casts what the page itself is playing. It keeps playing when you use other apps and shows a Live Activity on the lock screen saying what is running. One set of TV controls, a spinner while a cast starts, clearer wording about what is happening, and accessibility and iPad multitasking improvements.
Safari user agent, harder-to-detect video detection, and detection inside inline web workers
